latestVersion.changelog:
EdgeOne Pages Deployment Skill v1.0.0

- Initial release: deploy frontend and full-stack projects to EdgeOne Pages (Tencent EdgeOne).
- Strictly enforces CLI version (≥ 1.2.30) check before proceeding.
- Includes explicit user flow for site selection (China/Global) and auto-detects appropriate login method (browser or token).
- Provides options to save tokens securely and manages them in `.edgeone/.token`.
- Ensures deployment output parsing for the complete access URL (with required query parameters) and reveals Console URL and Project ID for user reference.
- Clarifies strict boundaries for when to trigger deployment and excludes troubleshooting or post-deploy debug scenarios.
